words.gloss: are those who do not live

literal: Blame being excluded, those who live indeed are those who live; fame being excluded, those who live indeed are those who do not live.
translation: Those who live free from blame are the ones who truly live; those who live without earning fame are those who do not live at all.
modern: பழி இல்லாமல் வாழ்பவர்களே உண்மையாக வாழ்பவர்கள்; புகழ் இல்லாமல் வாழ்பவர்கள் உயிரோடு இருந்தாலும் வாழாதவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts a meaningful life of honor with a meaningless existence. The poet defines true living through two conditions: the absence of blame (வசை) and the presence of fame (இசை). Those who live in such a way that they avoid reproach are celebrated as the truly living. On the other hand, those who exist without achieving any good reputation or fame are considered as good as dead, merely passing through life without truly living.
